public_rationale: Reuters' September 29, 2026 report gives four Anthropic obligation figures whose nominal sum is approximately $413.7 billion, but does not reconcile that sum to remaining uncancellable payments [e1]. Anthropic's filing, available October 26, reports approximately $265.6 billion in future fixed or minimum guaranteed purchase commitments as of June 30, 2026, excluding agreements without determinable minimum payments [e2]. The different dates and scopes do not establish a comparable September balance [e1, e2]. Neither item provides the OpenAI schedule or discount-related changes needed to settle the combined $1.3 trillion total and $413 billion uncancellable floor [e1, e2].
limitations: The reported nominal amounts are not reconciled to payments already made, overlap or the precise remaining uncancellable portion [e1, e2].
The evidence does not quantify how the cited discounts or contractual amendments affected remaining obligations [e1, e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Discounted compute and adjusted profits do not solve the problem that Anthropic and OpenAI have $1.3 trillion in compute commitments, at least $413 billion uncancellable.

statement.excerpt: their immediate response is to say that 2026 will be fine because of quarters with discounted compute costs and adjusted operating profits that don’t actually resolve the underlying problem that these companies have $1.3 trillion in compute commitments, with at least $413 billion of them being uncancellable.

from_speaker: discounted compute costs and adjusted operating profits
don’t actually resolve the underlying problem
our_interpretation: Assess the combined stock of outstanding multiyear compute obligations, not annual spending or cash already paid.
Treat $1.3 trillion as a rounded reported estimate, conventionally about $1.25–$1.35 trillion.
Use September 2026, the latest pre-post reporting month for the commitment snapshot. The contractual payment years are separate from that snapshot.
Treat the monetary basis as estimate because the post relies on reported private-company figures.
The testable reading of 'do not resolve' is that reporting adjusted profit or receiving temporary discounts does not itself discharge the remaining contractual obligations.
Uncancellable means the buyer cannot simply walk away; ordinary breach and default provisions do not automatically make an obligation freely cancellable.
criteria.support_condition: A reconciled, non-overlapping schedule establishes approximately $1.3 trillion of combined outstanding compute commitments, at least $413 billion without ordinary unilateral cancellation rights, and no discharge of those obligations merely from the cited discounts or profit adjustments.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish a combined total outside the rounded range, an uncancellable amount below $413 billion, or contractual amendments that materially discharge the obligations invoked by the claim.
